'''Playtesting''' is a format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>playtesting</code>). The card pool is Decipher-printed set ids 1&ndash;14 ([[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]]) and premium ids 101&ndash;112. It also includes current Virtual Sets 0&ndash;27 (ids 200&ndash;227) and the Virtual Premium Set (id 301). The Playtesting set (id 501) is also legal. Its definition sets the <code>playtesting</code> flag.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />
